definitions.explanation: A system of physical exercises designed to strengthen the body's core muscles, improve flexibility, and enhance overall body awareness. Named after Joseph Pilates, who developed the method.

examples.japanese: ピラティスを{始|はじ}めた。
{週|しゅう}に{二回|にかい}ピラティスに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to Pilates twice a week.

examples.japanese: ピラティスは{体幹|たいかん}を{鍛|きた}えるのに{効果的|こうかてき}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Pilates is said to be effective for strengthening the core.

notes:
Named after Joseph Pilates, who developed this exercise system in the early 20th century. Pilates has become very popular in Japan, particularly among women, as a form of exercise that improves posture, flexibility, and core strength without high-impact movements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピラティスをする: to do Pilates
- ピラティスに{通|かよ}う: to attend Pilates classes
- ピラティス{教室|きょうしつ}: Pilates class; Pilates studio
- マットピラティス: mat Pilates
- マシンピラティス: machine/reformer Pilates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヨガ: yoga — another popular mind-body exercise, often mentioned alongside Pilates
- ストレッチ: stretching — simpler flexibility exercises
- {体幹|たいかん}トレーニング: core training — focused specifically on strengthening the core muscles
